headline: Judge rules singer D4vd must stand trial in killing of 14-year-old girl
context: Prosecutors claim singer killed Celeste Rivas Hernandez after she threatened to expose relationship and ruin his music career A Los Angeles judge ruled on Monday that singer D4vd must stand trial over the killing, sexual abuse and mutilation of 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Prosecutors claim singer killed Celeste Rivas Hernandez after she threatened to expose relationship and ruin his music career A Los Angeles judge ruled on Monday that singer D4vd must stand trial over the killing, sexual abuse and mutilation of 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez. Judge Charlaine Olmedo decided after a five-day preliminary hearing that prosecutors had provided enough probable cause to put the 21-year-old singer, who was born David Burke, on trial. Prosecutors have claimed Burke killed Celeste after she threatened to expose their relationship and ruin his burgeoning music career. Continue reading...
sources.title: Judge rules singer D4vd must stand trial in killing of 14-year-old girl

sources.name: The New York Times
sources.summary: The decision capped a five-day preliminary hearing in which prosecutors detailed how and why they say the musician killed the 14-year-old Celeste Rivas Hernandez.
sources.title: D4vd Murder Case Can Go to Trial, Judge Rules
